description:
• Brand introduction: Laura Lumiere is a premium jewelry boutique specializing in a wide range of exquisite jewelry collections. The brand stands out for its dedication to craftsmanship, offering individually made pieces that symbolize love and carry emotional weight which is what our slogan means - We Craft Memories.
• Product description: 
The products from Laura Lumiere brand range from high-end, luxurious jewelry pieces adorned with high-quality gold and diamonds to more casual, everyday wear that maintains the brand's standard of elegance and quality. More precisely, each model available on the website can be made of one of the three types of gold: yellow, rose and white.  Some of our models have different diamond options (meaning the carat weight of the diamonds). It is also important to note that gold can be of different purity at the request of the client, and we also have the ability to make custom-made products according to the client's design or develop a model specifically for the client.
• USP (Unique Selling Point): Our unique selling point lies in its exclusive craftsmanship and the emotional value embedded in each jewelry piece, but also we offer lifetime warranty on every product, free shipping within the EU, and a 14-day return policy. Moreover, we offer good prices for our products, as well as discounts for customers who buy more than one product, to be more precise, 10% for every second product, and 20% for every third. 
• Payment terms: Payment can be made in any convenient way after 14 days after the client who placed the order has received it. If the customer returns the product within 14 days after receiving it and receives a full refund, no payment will be made to the affiliate marketer. 
• Other information: 
We places a significant emphasis on sustainability and ethical practices, sourcing materials responsibly and ensuring that every aspect of their operation reflects a commitment to not just the customers but also the environment. Our website offers a seamless shopping experience, showcasing products through high-quality renders, images and videos and providing detailed descriptions to assist customers in making informed decisions.
name: Laura Lumiere
